scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @hangul-rummikub/shared && npm run build --workspace @hangul-rummikub/server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,web,server --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @hangul-rummikub/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @hangul-rummikub/web" "npm run dev --workspace @hangul-rummikub/server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hangul-rummikub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @hangul-rummikub/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @hangul-rummikub/server
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @hangul-rummikub/shared && npm test --workspace @hangul-rummikub/web && npm test --workspace @hangul-rummikub/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hangul-rummikub/shared && npm run build --workspace @hangul-rummikub/web && npm run build --workspace @hangul-rummikub/server
